description: Use when an agent needs vectors for search, RAG, clustering or dedup. Input: text (GET) or POST JSON {texts:[...]} with up to 32 strings of max 2000 chars each. Output: model, dims (1024), embeddings with index and vector; compare with cosine similarity. Multilingual (100+ languages, strong Korean). Not stored. Example: ?text=x402%20pay-per-call%20API Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

text.description: One text to embed (1-2000 chars). For several, POST {"texts":[...]} (up to 32)

texts.description: JSON array of up to 32 strings (alternative to text; POST JSON preferred)

name: ai_embed
title: Text embeddings: multilingual BGE-M3 1024-dim vectors for up to 32 texts per call
